lines: Lyrics: Kenshi Yonezu
Lyrics: Yonezu Kenshi
Music: Kenshi Yonezu
Music: Yonezu Kenshi
Arrangement: Kenshi Yonezu / Koichiro Muroya
Arrangement: Yonezu Kenshi / Muroya Koichiro
Producer: Kenshi Yonezu
Producer: Yonezu Kenshi
If only this were a dream, how wonderful that would be
If everything were just a dream, how great that would be
Even now I still see you in my dreams
Even now I still dream of you
Like returning to fetch something I forgot
Like going back to retrieve a lost item
Dusting off the cobwebs of old memories
Brushing away the dust on ancient recollections
There are joys that will never return
There are happinesses that will never come back
In the end, you taught me
That was the last thing you taught me
The dark past I kept hidden, unable to speak
The bleak past I concealed, never uttered
Without you, darkness would remain forever
If you were gone, it would stay eternally dark
Surely there will be no more wounds to bear
There will be nothing else to hurt me
I understand that nothing more will happen
I know I cannot be hurt any further
Even the sorrow of that day
Even the grief of that day
Even the pain of that day
Even the anguish of that day
I loved all of it, together with you
I loved everything, as long as I was with you
It lingers in my chest, never leaving
It remains in my heart, refusing to depart
The scent of bitter lemon
The aroma of a sour lemon
I cannot go home until the rain stops
I won’t return until the rain ceases
Even now, you are my light
Even today, you remain my light
In the darkness I traced your back
In the night I followed the outline of your spine
I remember that silhouette with crystal clarity
I recall every contour vividly
Each time I meet something I cannot grasp
Whenever I confront the uncontainable
Only tears overflow endlessly
The only thing that keeps pouring is my tears
What were you doing then?
What were you doing?
What were you looking at?
What did you see?
With a profile I never knew
With a side view I had never seen
Somewhere, now, you
If somewhere, right now, you
Are just like me
Are the same as I am
If you are drowning in tears, lost in loneliness
If you are immersed in tears, within solitude
Please, forget about me
Just forget me, I beg you
I wish that from the bottom of my heart
I earnestly hope for that
Even now, you are my light
Even today, you remain my light
You fell in love more deeply than you thought you did
You loved more than you realized
Since then I can’t breathe as I used to
Since that day, I cannot breathe normally
We were so close, yet it feels like a lie
Even though we were right beside each other, it now seems like a falsehood
I cannot forget; that alone is certain
Only that is sure: I cannot forget
Even the sorrow of that day
Even the grief of that day
Even the pain of that day
Even the anguish of that day
I loved everything, together with you
I loved all of it, as long as I was with you
It stays in my chest, never leaving
It remains in my heart, refusing to depart
The scent of bitter lemon
The aroma of a sour lemon
I cannot go home until the rain stops
I won’t return until the rain ceases
Like one half of a split fruit
Like a half of a fruit that has been cut apart
Even now, you are my light
Even today, you remain my light
